title: Count output and scanned rows
brief: Distinguish output cardinality from scanned work.
instructions: Return every customer and their order count, including customers without orders.
Count matching orders, not the outer join placeholder.
Measure the complete result and its separate EXPLAIN ANALYZE profile.
Report outputRows as the complete result count.
Report scanRows as the sum of leaf operator_rows_scanned values.
If any required scan metric is absent, report not-reported.
starterSql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: The starter shows customer identities. Add order counts without removing customers who have no orders. EXPLAIN wrapper rows are not output cardinality.

hints.text: Use an outer join and count the matching order identity.
Group at customer identity before you compare output count and scanned work.
An orderless customer still has one output row, but zero matching orders. A missing scan metric is not zero.
